lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Guys,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: I'm concerned.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: The hospital gowns that our patients wear...

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: don't you think they're a bit unappealing?
I think they're quite comfortable.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: No one's saying they're not comfy,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: but if you ask me, they focus too much on functionality.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Meanwhile, the design has been left by the wayside. They're a major eyesore.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: You may have a point.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: They make it very easy for us doctors to conduct our examinations,

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: but they are rather dull.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: You've worn them on occasion,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Commander.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: What do you think of them?
Is design really all that important for hospital gowns?

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: It may not be at the top of the list, no,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: but hospitals are often places associated with fear and anxiety,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: so I want to reduce the stress for our patients as much as possible.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: That's very considerate of you, Pepper.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: It may not seem like much, but hospital gowns can absolutely evoke a certain atmosphere.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: We could use them to help alleviate tension among the patients.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Exactly!
I'll brainstorm and come up with a few potential designs.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: You're going to help as well, Commander?
Sure, why not?

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Let me know if there's any way I can lend a hand.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: I'll do whatever I can to help.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: I will,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: thank you both!
